error: On the dashboard the PL and DE cards carry each other's labels; values and claim ids are untouched.
warning_texts: release/dashboard_data.json shows the PL and DE net-revenue cards with swapped labels while the values are correct, so a dashboard reader reads each of the two country totals as the other country's.

No rule in audit/check_plan.json binds a dashboard card label to the country of its claim_id: gate_release_document checked only claims_rendered and caveats_rendered (presence), so the label swap passed both release gates with zero issues and this defect exists only in unverified territory the plan
summary: All 21 rendered numbers recompute exactly from raw_data/orders.csv, but release/dashboard_data.json swaps the country labels of the PL and DE cards: the card with claim_id CLM-NET-PL (11,181.67, the true PL total) is labeled 'Net revenue DE (EUR)' and the card with claim_id CLM-NET-DE (11,032.61, the true DE total) is labeled 'Net revenue PL (EUR)'. A dashboard reader is shown the wrong country on both cards.
